meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为你的编码 agent 接入多家模型服务商,改配置即可切换底层模型。
copy.tagline_en: Swap your coding agent's model provider to OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, or DeepSeek.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run an agent system and want to change its underlying model provider.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 的 agent 组可改用 OpenCode 作为 agent provider(默认 claude),接 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型。技能会拷入 provider 文件、装依赖并重建镜像。
howto.when: 当你想让某个 agent 组不用默认的 claude,而用 OpenCode 跑 agent 时会用到:先安装本技能,再用 ncl groups config update --provider opencode 切换该组。

say.text: 帮我装 add-opencode:拷入 provider 文件并重建镜像
say.note: 先做安装与校验,再继续配置

say.text: 把 <group-id> 组切换成 opencode provider,然后重启
把 OpenCode 的模型换成 DeepSeek 并配好密钥
say.note: 需先在 OneCLI 注册对应 API key

howto.what_en: After install, a NanoClaw agent group can run on OpenCode as its agent provider (default is claude), reaching OpenRouter, DeepSeek and more. The skill copies provider files, installs deps and rebuilds the image.
howto.when_en: Use it when a group should run agents through OpenCode instead of the default claude: install the skill, then switch that group with ncl groups config update --provider opencode.

say_en.text: Install add-opencode: copy the provider files and rebuild the image
say_en.note: Pre-flight checks, copies files, rebuilds the agent image

say_en.text: Switch group <group-id> to the opencode provider and restart it
say_en.note: Provider is written into container.json at spawn time

say_en.text: Configure OpenCode with DeepSeek and set up its API key
say_en.note: Register the provider key in OneCLI first
